example: P.O. is abbreviated from Post Office.
example_zh: P.O. 是 Post Office（郵局）的縮寫。
memory_hint: brevi 有「短」的聯想，因此 abbreviate 表縮短、縮寫。

example: She has just gone through with an abortion and her husband knew nothing about it.
example_zh: 她剛做了墮胎手術，而她丈夫對此一無所知。
memory_hint: abortion 可指流產或人工墮胎。

example: The professor abstracted his most significant views from his speech in the end. He made an abstract for his wife's book.
example_zh: 最後教授從演講中提取出最重要的觀點。他為妻子的書寫了內容概要。
chinese: 使抽象化；抽取；提取；摘要；概要
memory_hint: ab- 表離開，tract 表拉，引申為抽取；名詞則指從全文抽出的摘要。

example: The question is not purely academic and we had better put it at the first place.
example_zh: 這個問題不是純學術性的，我們最好把它放在第一位。
memory_hint: 由 academy（學院）引申為學術的、學院的。

example: The minority don't think this proposal is acceptable.
example_zh: 少部分人認為這個提議不可接受。
chinese: 可以接受的；令人滿意的
memory_hint: accept + able，表示可以被接受的。

example: Some of the document was purely accidental.
example_zh: 這份文件有些部分純屬意外。
chinese: 偶然的；意外的；非主要的
memory_hint: accident + al，表示偶然的、意外的。

example: His dream was finally accomplished after thirty years' hard work.
example_zh: 經過三十年的努力工作後，他的夢想終於實現了。
memory_hint: accomplish 表把事情完成並達成目標。

example: She is too young to be held accountable for her actions.
example_zh: 她太小，還不能對自己的行為負責。
chinese: 有解釋義務的；應負責任的
memory_hint: account + able，表示能被要求說明、負責。

example: He decided to go in for accounting for he was good at maths.
example_zh: 因為他數學很好，所以他決定從事會計職業。
memory_hint: account + ing，表示會計、會計學。

example: Stop watching TV for an accumulation of homework is waiting to be done.
example_zh: 別看電視了，有一堆家庭作業要做。
memory_hint: accumulate + ion，表示累積、積聚。

example: Acid rain is harmful to many plants and animals.
example_zh: 酸雨對許多動植物都有害。
memory_hint: acid + rain，字面即酸雨。

example: The freshman made a quick adaptation to the college.
example_zh: 這名新生很快就適應了大學生活。
memory_hint: adapt + ation，表示適應、改編。

example: There is no need to pay additional charges.
example_zh: 沒必要付額外的費用。
memory_hint: addition + al，表示附加的、額外的。

example: She can't adjust herself to the busy life in the city.
example_zh: 她不能適應城市裡的繁忙生活。
memory_hint: adjust oneself to 表示使自己適應。

example: She gained admission to the most famous university.
example_zh: 她獲准進入那所最著名的大學。
memory_hint: ad + miss + ion，可聯想為「准許進入」。

example: After second consideration she decided to adopt her friend's suggestion.
example_zh: 再三考慮後，她決定採用朋友的建議。
memory_hint: ad + opt，opt 表選擇，引申為選擇採用。

example: Her good education gave her advantage over other applicants for the job.
example_zh: 良好的教育使她比其他求職者更具有優勢。
memory_hint: advantage 指使人居於有利位置的條件。

example: You should advertise your new product.
example_zh: 你們應該為新產品做宣傳。
memory_hint: advertise 表向大眾宣傳、公告。

example: He advocated the new policy. She is a strong advocate of government reform.
example_zh: 他倡議新政策。她是政府改革的堅決提倡者。
chinese: 主張；提倡；支援；提倡者；擁護者
memory_hint: advocate 可作動詞「倡議」，也可作名詞「提倡者」。

example: The audiences were deeply affected by the deeds of the hero.
example_zh: 觀眾被那位英雄的事蹟深深感動了。
memory_hint: affect 常表示對情緒或狀態造成影響。

example: She affiliated herself with a local basketball club. Only affiliates are permitted to attend the party.
example_zh: 她加入當地的一家籃球俱樂部。只允許會員參加該聚會。
chinese: 使隸屬聯繫；使隸屬於；接納；會員；附屬機構；分公司
memory_hint: affiliate 可作動詞「使隸屬／加入」，也可作名詞「會員／附屬機構」。

example: He cannot afford a car right now.
example_zh: 他現在買不起汽車。
memory_hint: afford 常用於表示有能力負擔金錢或時間。

example: Many people lost their sons in the aftermath of the war.
example_zh: 戰爭過後，許多人失去了兒子。
memory_hint: aftermath 常指災難或不幸事件之後的後果、餘波。

example: He asked me what the next item on the agenda was.
example_zh: 他問我下一項議程是什麼。
memory_hint: agenda 指會議中要討論的事項或議程。

example: He aggravated his condition by overworking.
example_zh: 他因工作過度而病情惡化。
memory_hint: aggravate 表使情況更嚴重、惡化。

example: He predicted that the country would be an aging society in 150 years.
example_zh: 他預測一百五十年後這個國家將成為老齡化社會。
memory_hint: aging + society，表示人口逐漸老化的社會。

example: Agriculture is essential to the national economy.
example_zh: 農業對國家經濟很重要。
memory_hint: agri 表田地，culture 表耕作、培養，引申為農業。

example: The doctor alerted me to the harm of smoking. She was scared by a smog alert. The little girl is alert to every stranger passing by.
example_zh: 醫生提醒我注意吸煙的危害。她被煙霧警報嚇到了。這個小女孩對每個路過的陌生人都保持高度警覺。
chinese: 使警覺；使注意；通知；警戒；警報；警戒狀態；警覺的；留心的；靈敏的
memory_hint: alert 可作動詞、名詞與形容詞，核心概念是「警覺」。

example: Her father is allegedly a criminal.
example_zh: 據傳她父親是個罪犯。
memory_hint: alleged + ly，表示據稱、據傳。

example: She alleviated the stress by seeing films.
example_zh: 她藉由看電影來減輕壓力。
memory_hint: alleviate 表使痛苦、壓力等減輕。

example: You mustn't allude to his bankruptcy when talking with him.
example_zh: 和他談話時，你千萬不要提到他破產的事。
memory_hint: allude to 表間接提到、暗指。

example: What is the altitude of this mountain?
example_zh: 這座山的高度是多少？
memory_hint: altitude 指高度，尤指海拔高度。

example: She's offended by his ambiguous statement.
example_zh: 他模糊不清的陳述冒犯了她。
chinese: 模糊不清的；引起歧義的
memory_hint: ambiguous 表意思可有多種解釋、含糊不清。

example: She immediately noticed the amenity of her working surroundings.
example_zh: 她很快發現她工作環境的宜人之處。
memory_hint: amenity 指舒適、便利或宜人的條件。

example: He followed the advice of his financial analyst.
example_zh: 他聽從了金融分析師的建議。
memory_hint: analysis 的人員名詞是 analyst。

example: The loss of his brother anguished him deeply. He was in anguish until he knew his wife had passed a critical stage.
example_zh: 失去弟弟使他深陷痛苦之中。他一直處於極度痛苦中，直到知道妻子已渡過危險期。
chinese: 使極度痛苦；感到痛苦；極度的痛苦；苦惱
memory_hint: anguish 可作動詞或名詞，核心為極度痛苦。

example: He bought me a ring as an anniversary gift.
example_zh: 他買給我一個戒指作為週年紀念日禮物。
memory_hint: anniversary 指每年重複到來的紀念日。

example: The novel coming out anonymously is fathered upon John.
example_zh: 有人認為那本匿名發表的小說是約翰所寫。
memory_hint: anonymous + ly，表示匿名地。

example: The economist anticipated a financial crisis was coming.
example_zh: 那位經濟學家預料一場經濟危機即將爆發。
memory_hint: anticipate 表事先預料或期待。

example: The father was filled with anxiety about his son's study.
example_zh: 那位父親為兒子的學習感到憂心。
memory_hint: anxiety 表焦慮、憂心，也可指渴望。

example: I must apologize for not following my promise.
example_zh: 我為沒遵守諾言而道歉。
memory_hint: apologize 常用 apologize for 表示為某事道歉。

example: We were appalled when we heard a hurricane was on its way.
example_zh: 聽說一場颶風正席捲而來，我們嚇壞了。
memory_hint: appall 表使人極度震驚或害怕。

example: It was wrong to appease the aggressor.
example_zh: 姑息侵略者是錯誤的。
memory_hint: appease 表平息怒氣、緩和衝突或滿足需求。

example: The company has appointed a new secretary.
example_zh: 公司已經任命了一位新的秘書。
memory_hint: appoint 表任命或指定某人擔任職務。

example: I appreciate what you have done for me.
example_zh: 感謝你為我所做的一切。
memory_hint: appreciate 可表示欣賞、感激或理解價值。

example: They argued me into giving up the impractical plan.
example_zh: 他們說服我放棄這個不切實際的計畫。
memory_hint: argue someone into 表說服某人做某事。

example: The beautiful dress has arrested her attention. The policemen made an arrest last week.
example_zh: 那件漂亮的衣服吸引了她的注意。員警上星期逮捕了一個人。
chinese: 逮捕；拘留；阻止；吸引；逮捕；拘留
memory_hint: arrest 可作動詞與名詞，核心為「停止、扣留」。

example: There are many artifacts in his study.
example_zh: 在他的書房裡有很多手工藝品。
memory_hint: arti 表技藝、人工，fact 表做，引申為人工製品。

example: We made a successful ascent of the highest mountain in the world.
example_zh: 我們成功地登上了世界上最高的山。
memory_hint: ascent 表向上攀登、上升。

example: The cruel assassin finally suffered the consequence of his own doing.
example_zh: 那個殘忍的刺客終於自食其果。
memory_hint: assassin 指刺客、暗殺者。

example: He got 5 years' imprisonment due to assaulting an official. The troop made a strong assault on the city.
example_zh: 他因襲擊一位官員被判五年監禁。軍隊猛襲該城。
memory_hint: assault 可作動詞和名詞，均表示攻擊、襲擊。

example: The factory is more efficient due to the fact that a new assembly line was installed.
example_zh: 因為安裝了新的裝配線，所以工廠的效率提高了。
memory_hint: assembly 表裝配，line 表線，合起來是裝配線。

example: He refused to tell us his assessment of the situation.
example_zh: 他拒絕告訴我們他對該形勢的評估。
memory_hint: assess + ment，表示評估、評價。

example: All the employees have been assigned to suitable jobs.
example_zh: 所有的員工都已被分配到合適的工作。
memory_hint: assign 表把任務或職位分派給某人。

example: Nothing can assuage her pain of losing a child.
example_zh: 什麼也不能減輕她失去孩子的痛苦。
memory_hint: assuage 表使痛苦、怒氣等減輕。

example: The little boy's dream is to be an astronaut.
example_zh: 那個小男孩的夢想是成為太空人。
memory_hint: astro 表星、宇宙，naut 表航行者，合起來是太空人。

example: An atmosphere of anxiety filled the family.
example_zh: 家裡籠罩著憂慮的氣氛。
chinese: 大氣；大氣層；氣氛；情趣；魅力
memory_hint: atmo 表氣，sphere 表球面、範圍，引申為大氣與氣氛。

example: His atrocity has aroused great public rage.
example_zh: 他的暴行激起了群眾極大的憤怒。
memory_hint: atrocity 指殘暴行為或暴行。

example: They attend the church every Sunday.
example_zh: 每個星期天他們都去教堂。
memory_hint: attend 可指參加、出席，也可指注意、照顧。

example: What's your attitude towards this issue?
example_zh: 你對這個問題的看法是怎樣的？
memory_hint: attitude 常指對某事的態度或立場。

example: The company is going to auction their car next week. The building is sold by auction.
example_zh: 公司將於下月拍賣他們的車。這座樓房是被拍賣掉的。
memory_hint: auction 可作動詞與名詞，均與拍賣有關。

example: He augmented his income by being a part time teacher in a college.
example_zh: 因為他在一所大學當兼職老師，所以收入增加。
memory_hint: augment 表增加、擴大。

example: The interested parties have authenticated the rumor.
example_zh: 當事人已經證實了傳言為真。
memory_hint: authenticate 表證實真實性。

example: They want to buy a fully automatic washing machine.
example_zh: 他們想買一台全自動洗衣機。
memory_hint: auto 表「自己」，-matic 可聯想自動運作，因此 automatic 表自動的。

example: The average age of the employees in the company is 25. His pay is above the average in the company.
example_zh: 這家公司員工的平均年齡是二十五歲。他的薪水高於公司的平均薪資。
chinese: 平均的；一般的；普通的；平均；平均數；一般；普通
memory_hint: average 可作形容詞或名詞，核心是平均、一般水準。

example: We were surprised by his backlash of sympathy for his enemy.
example_zh: 他對仇敵表示同情的強烈反應，讓我們感到很驚訝。
chinese: 反衝；反撞；強烈反應；強烈反對
memory_hint: back 表「回」，lash 表「打擊」，合起來表示反衝、強烈反應。

example: The naked eye can not see bacteria.
example_zh: 肉眼看不到細菌。
memory_hint: bacteria 是 bacterium 的名詞複數形。

example: Nothing can balk me to pursue my dream. He thinks political movement is a balk to the development of economy.
example_zh: 沒有什麼能阻止我去追求我的夢想。他認為政治運動是經濟發展的障礙。
chinese: 阻礙；阻止；畏怯；猶豫；阻礙；妨礙；挫折
memory_hint: balk 可作動詞或名詞，表示阻礙、妨礙。

example: The bandits in the mountain were finally arrested.
example_zh: 山裡的強盜終於被逮捕了。
memory_hint: bandit 指強盜、土匪。

example: The king was banished from his country for life.
example_zh: 國王被終生放逐。
memory_hint: banish 表放逐、驅逐，也可表示消除。

example: Banking faces cruel competition in China nowadays.
example_zh: 當今，中國的銀行業面臨著殘酷的競爭。
memory_hint: bank 表「銀行」，-ing 為名詞字尾，合起來表示銀行業。
